description: Record a reviewer's decision on one saved playlist or one saved school policy. A playlist or a policy saved by any model is a draft, and every run against a draft says Unverified. Give playlist_id or policy_id, one and not both, with reviewer and decision: reviewed or rejected. note is optional. reviewer is a role label, never a person's name, and may not be the one that built the row (its built_by). A run drops the Unverified label only when its playlist and its school policy are both reviewed. Returns the review's id and the row's status.

note.description: Optional: what the reviewer wants kept with the decision

playlist_id.description: The playlist to review; give this or policy_id, not both

policy_id.description: The school policy to review; give this or playlist_id, not both

reviewer.description: Who reviewed it: a role label, never a person's name

name: playlist_review
title: Playlist Review
